patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-impact imagery and video are used as primary content blocks, often with large text overlays.
Extreme contrast in type scale, featuring massive, bold sans-serif headings against very small, regular-weight uppercase body and navigation text.
A minimalist black and white palette is punctuated by a single, vibrant orange accent color for key textual statements.
The hero text 'HOLIDAYS' scrolls with a parallax effect, moving slower than its video background, creating a sense of depth as content reveals from below.
The site transitions abruptly from a visually rich, full-screen hero and content grid to a stark, minimalist black footer section.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed video background that scrolls at a normal pace, while an oversized text overlay scrolls at a slower rate, creating a parallax effect. Subsequent content sections scroll normally, revealing themselves from beneath the hero. The detected 'video-hero' and 'css-keyframes' suggest the video is a background element and other reveals might use subtle CSS animations.
A prominent statement block uses a solid, vibrant accent color as its background, with white text, making it stand out sharply from the surrounding monochromatic content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, ultra-bold hero text (~10x body) contrasts sharply with small, regular-weight uppercase navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy; generous spacing around images and text blocks, especially in the hero and footer, creating a gallery-like feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, full-screen video hero with massive, parallaxing text, which then transitions to a highly curated, gallery-style content grid, culminating in an unexpectedly stark, minimalist black footer. The bold use of a single, vibrant accent color for a key statement also sets it apart.
